C1.claim: SAGE generative accuracy significantly exceeds the reference single-pass GPT-5 baseline (generative accuracy metric on probes conditioned on Gemma-2-2B + JumpReLU SAE features)
C1.evidence: Wilcoxon p=0.0455 (two-tailed), n=44 features, n_eff=4 (non-zero differences), delta_gen_acc=+0.018, CI=[0.005,0.036]. Technically significant but extremely low effective sample size.
C1.note: Phase 2 WARN: n_eff=4, 90.9% zero differences, fragile result

C2.claim: SAGE predictive accuracy (Pearson r on held-out Neuronpedia activations) significantly exceeds the reference baselines on the main pair (Gemma-2-2B + JumpReLU SAE)
C2.evidence: delta_pearson=-0.018, CI includes 0, negative direction. SAGE-lite does not outperform Neuronpedia reference.

C3.claim: SAGE performance advantage generalizes across early, middle, and late layers (L4, L12, L20 of Gemma-2-2B)
C3.evidence: Gen acc: L20 all-zero differences; layers show inconsistent advantage. Pred acc: all negative deltas. No layer-stratified significance.
C3.note: Phase 2 WARN: Bonferroni not coded, per-layer n=14-15

C4.claim: SAGE explanations consistently outperform reference baselines across architecturally distinct model+SAE pairs (cross-pair generalization)
C4.evidence: M2 (Qwen3-4B + transcoder-hp): SAGE-lite delta_pearson=+0.153, CI=[-0.039,+0.391] — positive but not significant. Only 2/3 planned depths tested (L28 absent).
C4.note: Phase 2 WARN: L28 missing, scope narrowed
